thereafter.en: The team revised the plan and thereafter followed the new schedule.
thereafter.zh: 團隊修改計畫後，之後都依照新時程進行。

thereby.en: The school reduced paper use, thereby lowering printing costs.
thereby.zh: 學校減少用紙，因此降低了列印成本。

thermometer.en: The science class used a thermometer to record the water temperature.
thermometer.zh: 自然課使用溫度計記錄水溫。

thesis.en: Her thesis presents a clear argument about urban transportation.
thesis.zh: 她的論文提出一個關於都市交通的清楚論點。

thief.en: The novel follows a thief who later returns what he stole.
thief.zh: 小說描寫一名小偷後來歸還偷走物品的故事。

thirst.en: After the long walk, everyone felt strong thirst.
thirst.zh: 長途步行後，每個人都感到非常口渴。

thirsty.en: The hikers became thirsty after walking under the afternoon sun.
thirsty.zh: 健行者在午後陽光下走了一段路後感到口渴。

thorough.en: The teacher gave every report a thorough review before grading.
thorough.zh: 老師在評分前仔細審閱了每份報告。

thoughtful.en: Her thoughtful question led to a deeper classroom discussion.
thoughtful.zh: 她深思熟慮的問題帶來更深入的課堂討論。

thread.en: A loose thread was hanging from the edge of the bag.
thread.zh: 包包邊緣垂著一根鬆掉的線。

threat.en: Flooding is a serious threat to homes near the river.
threat.zh: 洪水對河邊住家構成嚴重威脅。

threaten.en: Rising temperatures threaten some species in mountain environments.
threaten.zh: 升高的氣溫威脅部分山區物種。

threshold.en: The sensor activates when the temperature passes a set threshold.
threshold.zh: 溫度超過設定門檻時，感應器就會啟動。

tighten.en: Please tighten the loose strap before carrying the backpack.
tighten.zh: 背背包前請把鬆掉的背帶拉緊。

tile.en: A cracked tile near the doorway was replaced yesterday.
tile.zh: 門口附近一塊裂掉的磁磚昨天被換掉了。

till.en: The library stays open till nine on weekdays.
till.zh: 圖書館平日開放到晚上九點。

tilt.en: Tilt the screen slightly to reduce the glare from the window.
tilt.zh: 把螢幕稍微傾斜，可以減少窗戶反光。

timber.en: The old bridge was built mainly from local timber.
timber.zh: 這座老橋主要以當地木材建造。

timetable.en: The new timetable gives students more time between classes.
timetable.zh: 新的課表讓學生在課與課之間有更多時間。

timid.en: The timid cat slowly approached the food near the doorway.
timid.zh: 那隻膽小的貓慢慢靠近門邊的食物。

tin.en: The exhibit includes a small tin box from the early twentieth century.
tin.zh: 展覽中有一個二十世紀初的小鐵盒。

tip.en: The teacher gave us a useful tip for remembering the formula.
tip.zh: 老師給了我們一個記住公式的實用技巧。

tiptoe.en: She began to tiptoe across the room while everyone was reading.
tiptoe.zh: 大家閱讀時，她開始踮著腳走過房間。

tire.en: The bicycle needs a new tire before the next trip.
tire.zh: 下次出遊前，這輛自行車需要換一條新輪胎。

tired.en: He felt tired after finishing several hours of practice.
tired.zh: 完成幾個小時的練習後，他感到疲倦。

tiresome.en: Repeating the same task all afternoon became tiresome.
tiresome.zh: 整個下午重複同一項工作變得很令人厭倦。

tissue.en: She used a tissue to wipe water from the desk.
tissue.zh: 她用面紙擦掉桌上的水。

toast.en: He ate toast with fruit before leaving for school.
toast.zh: 他上學前吃了吐司和水果。

toe.en: The shoe felt tight around my big toe.
toe.zh: 這雙鞋在我的大拇趾附近感覺很緊。

tofu.en: The lunch box included tofu, vegetables, and rice.
tofu.zh: 便當裡有豆腐、蔬菜和白飯。

toilet.en: The station has a public toilet beside the waiting area.
toilet.zh: 車站候車區旁有公共廁所。

token.en: Each participant received a small token after the workshop.
token.zh: 每位參與者在工作坊後都收到一個小紀念品。

tolerable.en: The noise became tolerable after the windows were closed.
tolerable.zh: 窗戶關上後，噪音變得可以忍受。

tolerance.en: The lesson emphasizes tolerance for people with different backgrounds.
tolerance.zh: 課堂強調對不同背景的人保持包容。

tolerant.en: A tolerant classroom allows students to express different opinions respectfully.
tolerant.zh: 包容的課堂讓學生能尊重地表達不同意見。

toll.en: The bridge toll is collected electronically at the entrance.
toll.zh: 這座橋的通行費在入口以電子方式收取。

tomato.en: She sliced a tomato and added it to the sandwich.
tomato.zh: 她切了一顆番茄放進三明治。

tomb.en: Archaeologists studied an ancient tomb discovered near the ruins.
tomb.zh: 考古學家研究在遺址附近發現的一座古墓。

ton.en: The truck can carry more than one ton of equipment.
ton.zh: 這輛卡車可以載超過一公噸的設備。

tone.en: The writer uses a calm tone throughout the article.
tone.zh: 作者整篇文章都使用平靜的語氣。

tongue.en: The diagram labels the tongue as part of the human mouth.
tongue.zh: 圖表把舌頭標示為人口腔的一部分。

tooth.en: The model shows the structure of a human tooth.
tooth.zh: 這個模型展示人類牙齒的構造。

toothache.en: The health lesson explains common reasons for a toothache.
toothache.zh: 健康課說明牙痛的常見原因。

toothbrush.en: He packed a toothbrush in his bag for the overnight trip.
toothbrush.zh: 他為過夜旅行在包包裡放了一支牙刷。

top.en: The book was placed on the top shelf of the cabinet.
top.zh: 那本書被放在櫃子的最上層。

tornado.en: The documentary explains how a tornado forms during severe storms.
tornado.zh: 紀錄片說明龍捲風如何在強烈暴風雨中形成。

torrent.en: Heavy rain turned the small stream into a fast torrent.
torrent.zh: 大雨把小溪變成湍急水流。

tortoise.en: A tortoise moved slowly across the dry path in the zoo.
tortoise.zh: 動物園裡一隻陸龜慢慢走過乾燥小徑。

toss.en: She gave the ball a gentle toss across the yard.

tough.en: The final question was tough, but most students kept trying.
tough.zh: 最後一題很難，但大多數學生仍繼續嘗試。
